ops.title: daemonkit v0.21 flag day closed: 13/13 fleet, gate now fails a skipped consumer
ops.body:
Every consumer in the fleet-build matrix now compiles against daemonkit v0.21.
cc-pool was the last holdout on v0.20.9; it shipped as v0.65.0 (main 2a62759)
after the round-five fixes, and Fleet build on f853092 is 13/13: synckit,
fusekit, reposync, captain-hook, cc-notes, cc-patch, cc-orchestrate,
cc-interact, binrun, cc-present, cc-review, cc-pool, cookiesync.

That number is only meaningful because f853092 also landed the gate. Before it,
a consumer whose checkout was denied printed a warning, skipped its build steps
via `if: steps.consumer.outcome == 'success'`, and reported the leg GREEN — so
"13/13" could have meant "n built, 13-n never compiled". The denied checkout now
exits 1, the per-step guards are gone, and release requires the Fleet build
workflow (`workflow_call` added so release.yml can invoke it).

Consumers sit on assorted v0.21.x (0.21.0 through 0.21.4), which is fine — the
bar is that no consumer resolves v0.20.x, not that everyone is on the tip.

Verify the claim from scratch with:
  gh run list --branch main --limit 15 --json headSha,workflowName,conclusion
and per-consumer:
  git -C <repo> grep -hoE 'github.com/yasyf/daemonkit v[0-9.]+' origin/main -- go.mod
Read the matrix from .github/workflows/fleet-build.yml rather than a typed list
— an earlier check in this session used a hand-written consumer list that
omitted reposync, cc-patch, binrun, cc-review, and cookiesync while including
repos that are not consumers at all.
